title: CgPHB2 involved in the haemocyte mitophagy in response to Vibrio splendidus stimulation in Pacific oyster Crassostrea gigas.
authors: Li, Shurong; Sun, Jiejie; Li, Yinan; Lv, Xiaoqian; Wang, Lingling; Song, Linsheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究太平洋牡蛎中CgPHB2介导线粒体自噬的抗菌免疫功能，仅用分子对接模拟蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法核心应用，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Prohibitin2 (PHB2) is recently identified as a novel inner membrane mitophagy receptor to mediate mitophagy. In the present study, the function of CgPHB2 in mediating mitophagy in response to Vibrio splendidus stimulation was investigated in Crassostrea gigas. CgPHB2 protein was mainly distributed in the cytoplasm of three subpopulations of haemocytes. After V. splendidus stimulation, the expressions of CgPHB2 mRNA in haemocytes were up-regulated significantly at 6, 12 and 24 h, and the abundance of CgPHB2 protein was also enhanced at 12-24 h compared to control group. Furthermore, the green signals of CgPHB2 were colocalized respectively with the red signals of mitochondria and CgLC3 in the haemocytes at 12 h after V. splendidus stimulation, and the co-localization value of CgPHB2 and mtphagy Dye was significantly increased. The direct interaction between CgPHB2 and CgLC3 was simulated by molecular docking. In PHB2-inhibitor Fluorizoline-treated oysters, the mRNA expressions of mitophagy-related genes and the ratio of mitophagy were significantly decreased in haemocytes of oysters after V. splendidus stimulation. All the results collectively suggested that CgPHB2 participated in mediating the haemocyte mitophagy in the antibacterial immune response of oysters.
abstract_zh: Prohibitin2 (PHB2) 最近被鉴定为一种新型的内膜线粒体自噬受体，用于介导线粒体自噬。在本研究中，探讨了CgPHB2在长牡蛎（Crassostrea gigas）中响应灿烂弧菌（Vibrio splendidus）刺激介导线粒体自噬的功能。CgPHB2蛋白主要分布于血细胞三个亚群的细胞质中。在灿烂弧菌刺激后，血细胞中CgPHB2 mRNA的表达在6、12和24小时显著上调，与对照组相比，CgPHB2蛋白的丰度在12-24小时也增强。此外，在灿烂弧菌刺激后12小时，CgPHB2的绿色信号分别与线粒体和CgLC3的红色信号在血细胞中共定位，且CgPHB2与mtphagy Dye的共定位值显著增加。通过分子对接模拟了CgPHB2与CgLC3之间的直接相互作用。在用PHB2抑制剂Fluorizoline处理的牡蛎中，灿烂弧菌刺激后，牡蛎血细胞中线粒体自噬相关基因的mRNA表达和线粒体自噬比率显著降低。所有结果共同表明，CgPHB2参与介导牡蛎抗菌免疫反应中的血细胞线粒体自噬。
